title: KitchenAid KSDG950ESS1 bake heating element replacement
seoTitle: KitchenAid KSDG950ESS1 Bake Element Repair in Carmel, IN | Alex Appliance Repair
description: KitchenAid KSDG950ESS1 30-inch dual-fuel range repair in Carmel, IN. Bake mode did not heat, damaged bake element replaced, and temperature checked.
summary: Bake mode no-heat diagnosis, damaged bake heating element replacement and post-repair temperature check.
problem: Oven would not heat in Bake mode
causeHeading: Why the Bake mode stopped heating
causeExplanation: The service record identifies visible damage on the bake heating element. On this dual-fuel range, the surface burners and electric oven heating system are separate. A damaged bake element can keep the oven from heating properly in Bake mode, but controls, sensors and wiring should still be evaluated before parts are approved. This repair story documents the damaged element and replacement work without adding unrecorded resistance readings or temperature values.
